long_biography.plain_text:
Eisenmann began as a Stuttgart engineering office founded by Peter Eisenmann's father, Eugen. Peter joined as co-managing director in 1973 and assumed leadership when his father retired four years later. He expanded the Böblingen business into an international supplier of painting systems, environmental technology and automated material handling.

Under his leadership, the group established overseas production and supplied increasingly complex turnkey plants to global manufacturers. By 2018 it controlled 27 sites in 15 countries and reported €862 million in annual sales. A customer collapse later brought financial strain; the family rejected a Chinese takeover approach, and the company eventually entered insolvency.

Mallorca Zeitung reported him as 78 in August 2019, one to two years older than those sources imply. The year 1942 is proposed at high rather than very-high confidence, while the precise date and birthplace remain unproposed.

Reliable sources describe Eisenmann as Swabian and resident in Gstaad but do not establish citizenship. German nationality, Swiss nationality, dual nationality and a secondary residence therefore remain unproposed rather than being inferred from regional identity, residence or company location.

The family-transfer origin is a permitted medium-confidence inference, not a claim of inheritance. The core company was founded by Eugen Eisenmann; Peter was his son and operating successor; and Bilanz later attributed the fortune to Peter and identified him as controller. No reviewed source reveals whether the stake passed by inheritance, lifetime transfer, intra-family purchase or another legal mechanism.

Manufacturing is certain as the wealth-creation sector. It is also used as the disclosed primary-industry fallback because evidence does not rank Peter Eisenmann's current holdings after his ownership denial and the former group's insolvency. Es Fangar is a substantial, long-running agricultural and wine enterprise but is not shown to outweigh retained industrial wealth or other assets.
